name: Automatic Rust contracts and an additional TAST checker
description: Ordinary PureScript accepts ownership violations; a restricted separate pass consumes contracts extracted from Rust.

cases.reason: Ordinary PureScript permits the safe sequence.
Ordinary PureScript also permits double consume via alias.
Constructing an Effect is distinct from executing it twice.
The base type system has no ownership information.
A helper can capture a handle and be called twice.
Rust ownership is affine: automatic destruction is allowed.
A safe branch which exceeds this tiny supplementary checker.
An effect capturing a handle may escape ordinary PureScript.
Rust shared/mutable argument distinctions disappear from ordinary PureScript signatures.
Two separately allocated resources may be borrowed in one call.
An unknown pure foreign call may have ownership effects and must not be silently ignored by an added checker.
